name: Automation & Advanced Tools (MMCE, RF Tools, etc.)

pages.text: $(li)Modular Machines (MMCE) multiblocks can be auto-built by right-clicking the controller block with a stick.$(li)RF Tools scanner can copy tile entities and use them in shape cards, bypassing Building Gadget’s TE limitation.
$(li)Use modular platform templates (Crossroad and Section) for faster multiblock construction.
$(li)Avoid relying solely on Building Gadget for multiblocks involving tile entities—use RF Tools or manual placement instead.
